SELECT loan_id, classification_date
FROM (
    SELECT rc.loan_id, rc.as_of_date AS classification_date,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rc.loan_id ORDER BY rc.as_of_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM risk_classification rc
    JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
    WHERE cg.grade_name_zh = '次级'
) t
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY loan_id ASC;

SELECT payment_id, business_date, amount
FROM payment_event
WHERE payment_type = 'CASH_WITHDRAWAL'
  AND amount > 5000000
ORDER BY amount DESC;

SELECT p.party_id, pp.annual_income
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE pp.annual_income > 1000000
ORDER BY pp.annual_income DESC;

SELECT card_id, issued_on, expires_on
FROM payment_card
WHERE card_type = 'CREDIT'
ORDER BY issued_on ASC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    op.operating_status AS 经营状态
FROM party p
JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON p.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
  AND ou.region_code = (
      SELECT region_code 
      FROM organization_unit 
      WHERE unit_name = '上海分行'
      LIMIT 1
  )
ORDER BY p.party_id ASC;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
LEFT JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count
FROM organization_unit ou
LEFT JOIN account a ON a.org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY account_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.sector_name_zh AS 行业中文名称,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS 合同金额合计
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN industry_sector i ON op.industry_code = i.sector_code
WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
GROUP BY i.sector_name_zh
ORDER BY 合同金额合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_name AS 产品名称,
    ROUND(SUM(phs.fair_value), 2) AS 持仓市值合计
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
GROUP BY wp.product_id, wp.product_name
ORDER BY 持仓市值合计 DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id AS 机构单元编号,
    ou.unit_name AS 机构单元名称,
    COUNT(pr.relation_id) AS 关联方关系数量
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN party p ON pr.source_party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN organization_unit ou ON p.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 关联方关系数量 DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital, 2) AS net_capital,
    ROUND(cs.risk_weighted_assets, 2) AS risk_weighted_assets
FROM capital_snapshot cs
JOIN institution i ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
ORDER BY cs.net_capital DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    ROUND(SUM(bs.ledger_balance), 2) AS 存款余额合计
FROM account a
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN account_balance_snapshot bs ON a.account_id = bs.account_id
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND bs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 存款余额合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(AVG(d.principal_overdue_days), 2) AS avg_overdue_days
FROM delinquency_snapshot d
JOIN loan_drawdown l ON d.loan_id = l.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON l.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING AVG(d.principal_overdue_days) > 90
ORDER BY AVG(d.principal_overdue_days) DESC;

SELECT 
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS exposure_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) AS exposure_ratio
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON egm.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON eg.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, cs.net_capital
ORDER BY exposure_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.sector_name_zh AS 行业名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS 贷款笔数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cg.is_nonperforming = 1 THEN ld.loan_id END) AS 不良笔数,
    ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cg.is_nonperforming = 1 THEN ld.loan_id END) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id), 6) AS 不良笔数占比
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
JOIN industry_sector i ON op.industry_code = i.sector_code
LEFT JOIN risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id AND rc.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
LEFT JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
GROUP BY i.sector_code, i.sector_name_zh
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) >= 20
ORDER BY 不良笔数占比 DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS 合同金额合计
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 合同金额合计 DESC
LIMIT 15;

SELECT 
    wp.risk_level,
    COUNT(wp.product_id) AS product_count,
    ROUND(AVG(wp.management_fee_rate), 4) AS avg_management_fee_rate
FROM wealth_product wp
GROUP BY wp.risk_level
ORDER BY wp.risk_level ASC;

SELECT 
    gc.guarantor_party_id AS 担保人编号,
    p.display_name AS 担保人名称,
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS 在保余额合计
FROM guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN party p ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name
HAVING SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) > 500000000
ORDER BY 在保余额合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    pr.source_party_id AS 客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS 合同金额合计
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN party p ON pr.source_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id
WHERE pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
GROUP BY pr.source_party_id, p.display_name
HAVING SUM(ca.contract_amount) > 300000000
ORDER BY SUM(ca.contract_amount) DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(ds.record_id) AS record_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ds.observed_value), 2) AS total_observed_value
FROM data_security_event_v3 ds
JOIN institution i ON ds.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE ds.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_observed_value DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS overdue_record_count
FROM regulatory_submission_event_v3 rse
JOIN institution i ON rse.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE (rse.completion_date IS NULL OR rse.completion_date > rse.deadline_date)
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY overdue_record_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets, 6) AS capital_adequacy_ratio
FROM capital_snapshot cs
JOIN institution i ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY capital_adequacy_ratio ASC;

SELECT 
    d.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    d.principal_overdue_days AS 逾期天数,
    g.grade_name_zh AS 分类名称,
    r.as_of_date AS 分类日期
FROM delinquency_snapshot d
JOIN (
    SELECT loan_id, as_of_date, grade_code
    FROM risk_classification
    WHERE as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date)
        FROM risk_classification r2
        WHERE r2.loan_id = risk_classification.loan_id
    )
) r ON d.loan_id = r.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade g ON r.grade_code = g.grade_code
WHERE d.principal_overdue_days > 90
  AND g.grade_code IN ('NORMAL', 'SPECIAL_MENTION')
ORDER BY d.principal_overdue_days DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS insufficient_provision_loan_balance
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id AND ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(lbs.principal_balance) > 100000000
ORDER BY insufficient_provision_loan_balance DESC;

SELECT 
    pi.instruction_id AS 支付指令编号,
    pi.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    p.display_name AS 收款方名称,
    ind.sector_name_zh AS 行业中文名称,
    pi.instruction_amount AS 指令金额
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN party p ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN industry_sector ind ON op.industry_code = ind.sector_code
WHERE pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
  AND ind.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT')
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ind.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT') THEN pi.instruction_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS 违规流入金额,
    ROUND(SUM(pi.instruction_amount), 2) AS 指令金额合计,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ind.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT') THEN pi.instruction_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(pi.instruction_amount), 0), 6) AS 占比
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN party p ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
LEFT JOIN industry_sector ind ON op.industry_code = ind.sector_code
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 占比 DESC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_id AS 产品编号,
    wp.product_name AS 产品名称,
    ma.asset_id AS 底层资产编号,
    ma.maturity_on AS 资产到期日,
    wp.actual_termination_on AS 产品终止日
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
WHERE ma.maturity_on > wp.actual_termination_on
ORDER BY ma.maturity_on DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 主体编号,
    p.display_name AS 名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) AS 担保承诺笔数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS 借款协议笔数
FROM party p
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 担保承诺笔数 DESC;

SELECT 
    pe.payment_id AS 交易编号,
    pe.business_date AS 业务日期,
    ptc.name_zh AS 交易类型中文名称,
    pe.amount AS 金额,
    ou.unit_name AS 经办机构单元名称
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN payment_type_catalog ptc ON pe.payment_type = ptc.payment_type
LEFT JOIN organization_unit ou ON pe.origin_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
  AND pe.amount > 5000000
  AND pe.status = 'SETTLED'
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id AS 协议编号,
    p.display_name AS 借款人名称,
    ind_borrower.sector_name_zh AS 借款人注册行业名称,
    ind_target.sector_name_zh AS 协议投向行业名称,
    ca.contract_amount AS 合同金额
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
LEFT JOIN industry_sector ind_borrower ON op.industry_code = ind_borrower.sector_code
LEFT JOIN industry_sector ind_target ON ca.target_industry_code = ind_target.sector_code
WHERE ca.target_industry_code IS NOT NULL
  AND op.industry_code IS NOT NULL
  AND ca.target_industry_code <> op.industry_code
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    pe.payment_id AS 交易编号,
    pe.business_date AS 业务日期,
    pe.amount AS 金额,
    ah_from.party_id AS 付款方客户编号,
    ah_to.party_id AS 收款方客户编号
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account acc_from ON pe.from_account_id = acc_from.account_id
JOIN account acc_to ON pe.to_account_id = acc_to.account_id
JOIN account_holder ah_from ON acc_from.account_id = ah_from.account_id AND ah_from.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN account_holder ah_to ON acc_to.account_id = ah_to.account_id AND ah_to.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN party_relation pr ON (
    (pr.source_party_id = ah_from.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = ah_to.party_id)
    OR
    (pr.source_party_id = ah_to.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = ah_from.party_id)
)
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
WHERE pe.status = 'SETTLED'
  AND rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id AS 协议编号,
    p.display_name AS 借款人名称,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS 借据笔数
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(ld.loan_id) >= 3
ORDER BY 借据笔数 DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS 笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS 金额合计
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account a ON pe.from_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
  AND pe.amount > 5000000
  AND pe.status = 'SETTLED'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(pe.payment_id) >= 50
ORDER BY 金额合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    sm.staff_id AS 员工工号,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS 笔数
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account to_acc ON pe.to_account_id = to_acc.account_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON to_acc.account_id = ah.account_id AND ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN party p ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN industry_sector ind ON op.industry_code = ind.sector_code
JOIN service_operator so ON pe.operator_id = so.operator_id
JOIN staff_member sm ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
WHERE ind.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT')
GROUP BY sm.staff_id
ORDER BY 笔数 DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    r.record_id AS 台账记录编号,
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    r.event_date AS 事项发生日期,
    r.deadline_date AS 法定截止日期,
    CAST(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(r.deadline_date) AS INTEGER) AS 距截止日的天数差
FROM customer_due_diligence_event_v3 r
JOIN institution i ON r.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE r.completion_date IS NULL
  AND r.deadline_date IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 距截止日的天数差 DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id,
    cl.collateral_id,
    ca.status AS collateral_status,
    sa.status AS security_status
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
JOIN collateral_asset ca ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE ca.status = 'RELEASED'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY sa.security_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ca.agreement_id AS 协议编号,
    sa.security_id AS 担保合同编号,
    sa.secured_amount AS 担保债权金额
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE ld.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY sa.secured_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    lb.loan_id,
    lb.principal_balance,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.institution_id ORDER BY lb.principal_balance DESC, lb.loan_id ASC) AS balance_rank
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lb
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON lb.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE lb.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lb.principal_balance = (
      SELECT MAX(lb2.principal_balance)
      FROM loan_balance_snapshot lb2
      JOIN loan_drawdown ld2 ON lb2.loan_id = ld2.loan_id
      JOIN credit_agreement ca2 ON ld2.agreement_id = ca2.agreement_id
      WHERE ca2.institution_id = i.institution_id
        AND lb2.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  )
ORDER BY i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    i.sector_name_zh AS 行业中文名称,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS 本金余额,
    rn AS 排名
FROM (
    SELECT 
        loan_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY industry_code ORDER BY principal_balance DESC) AS rn
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            ld.loan_id,
            op.industry_code,
            lbs.principal_balance
        FROM loan_drawdown ld
        JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
        JOIN organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
        JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
        WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    ) t
) ranked
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ranked.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
JOIN industry_sector i ON ranked.industry_code = i.sector_code
WHERE ranked.rn <= 3
ORDER BY i.sector_name_zh ASC, ranked.rn ASC;

SELECT 
    business_date,
    COUNT(*) AS daily_count,
    COUNT(*) - LAG(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY business_date) AS change_from_previous
FROM payment_event
GROUP BY business_date
ORDER BY business_date ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ld.loan_id,
    lbs.principal_balance,
    ROUND(avg_bal.avg_principal, 2) AS institution_avg_balance,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance - avg_bal.avg_principal, 2) AS excess_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN (
    SELECT ca.institution_id, AVG(lbs2.principal_balance) AS avg_principal
    FROM loan_drawdown ld2
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld2.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs2 ON ld2.loan_id = lbs2.loan_id
    WHERE lbs2.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
) avg_bal ON ca.institution_id = avg_bal.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.principal_balance > avg_bal.avg_principal
ORDER BY excess_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM security_agreement sa
LEFT JOIN collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
WHERE cl.collateral_link_id IS NULL
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY sa.secured_amount DESC;

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN d.principal_overdue_days = 0 THEN '未逾期'
    WHEN d.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN '1-30天'
    WHEN d.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN '31-90天'
    WHEN d.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN '91-180天'
    WHEN d.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 181 AND 360 THEN '181-360天'
    ELSE '360天以上'
  END AS overdue_interval,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM delinquency_snapshot d
WHERE d.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY overdue_interval
ORDER BY MIN(d.principal_overdue_days);

SELECT 
    collateral_id,
    valued_on,
    COUNT(*) AS duplicate_count
FROM collateral_valuation
GROUP BY collateral_id, valued_on
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY collateral_id ASC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS 贷款笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS 本金余额合计,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id), 2) AS 平均单笔金额
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 平均单笔金额 DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    ou.unit_name AS 机构单元名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS 员工人数,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS 经办笔数
FROM organization_unit ou
LEFT JOIN staff_member sm ON sm.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
LEFT JOIN service_operator so ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
LEFT JOIN payment_event pe ON pe.operator_id = so.operator_id
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 经办笔数 DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    p.customer_segment AS 客户分层,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.party_id) AS 客户数量,
    ROUND(AVG(pp.annual_income), 2) AS 平均年收入,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN pp.annual_income > 1000000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT p.party_id), 6) AS 高收入客户占比
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY p.customer_segment
ORDER BY p.customer_segment ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rt.relation_type IS NOT NULL THEN pe.amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS related_party_txn_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS total_txn_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rt.relation_type IS NOT NULL THEN pe.amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(pe.amount), 0), 6) AS related_party_ratio
FROM payment_event pe
LEFT JOIN account from_acc ON pe.from_account_id = from_acc.account_id
LEFT JOIN account to_acc ON pe.to_account_id = to_acc.account_id
LEFT JOIN account_holder from_holder ON from_acc.account_id = from_holder.account_id AND from_holder.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
LEFT JOIN account_holder to_holder ON to_acc.account_id = to_holder.account_id AND to_holder.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
LEFT JOIN party_relation pr ON pr.source_party_id = from_holder.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = to_holder.party_id
LEFT JOIN relation_type_catalog rt ON pr.relation_type = rt.relation_type AND rt.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
LEFT JOIN institution i ON COALESCE(from_acc.institution_id, to_acc.institution_id) = i.institution_id
WHERE pe.status = 'SETTLED'
  AND pe.business_date <= '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY related_party_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) AS 持有贷记卡数量,
    COUNT(DISTINCT td.account_id) AS 定期存款账户数量
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
LEFT JOIN payment_card pc ON p.party_id = pc.holder_party_id AND pc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
LEFT JOIN term_deposit td ON p.party_id IN (
    SELECT ah.party_id 
    FROM account_holder ah 
    WHERE ah.account_id = td.account_id
)
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
  AND p.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND pc.card_id IS NOT NULL
  AND td.account_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 定期存款账户数量 DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(AVG(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(ld.disbursed_on)), 2) AS avg_aging_days
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY avg_aging_days DESC;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        loan_id,
        principal_balance,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY principal_balance DESC) AS quartile_group
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT 
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    quartile_group
FROM ranked
ORDER BY quartile_group ASC, principal_balance DESC, loan_id ASC
LIMIT 40;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        i.sector_name_zh AS industry_name,
        ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS balance_total,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(lbs.principal_balance) DESC) AS rn
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
    JOIN industry_sector i ON op.industry_code = i.sector_code
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY i.sector_name_zh
),
cumulative AS (
    SELECT 
        industry_name,
        balance_total,
        ROUND(SUM(balance_total) OVER (ORDER BY rn) * 1.0 / SUM(balance_total) OVER (), 6) AS cum_ratio
    FROM ranked
)
SELECT 
    industry_name,
    balance_total,
    cum_ratio
FROM cumulative
WHERE cum_ratio <= 0.8
ORDER BY cum_ratio ASC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS 未结清借据笔数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(ld.loan_id) >= 2
ORDER BY COUNT(ld.loan_id) DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    ca.collateral_id,
    cv.latest_valuation_amount
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
JOIN collateral_asset ca ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
JOIN (
    SELECT collateral_id, MAX(valued_on) AS max_valued_on
    FROM collateral_valuation
    GROUP BY collateral_id
) mv ON ca.collateral_id = mv.collateral_id
JOIN collateral_valuation cv ON mv.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id AND mv.max_valued_on = cv.valued_on
WHERE cv.valuation_amount > 2 * sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY (cv.valuation_amount - sa.secured_amount) DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.institution_id) AS 开户机构家数
FROM party p
JOIN account_holder ah ON p.party_id = ah.party_id
JOIN account a ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.institution_id) > 1
ORDER BY 开户机构家数 DESC;

SELECT 
    pe.from_account_id AS account_id,
    pe.business_date AS transaction_date,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM payment_event pe
WHERE pe.status = 'SETTLED'
GROUP BY pe.from_account_id, pe.business_date
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.party_id) AS 集团成员户数,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS 余额合计
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
LEFT JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
LEFT JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
LEFT JOIN account_holder ah ON ld.loan_account_id = ah.account_id
LEFT JOIN party p ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON p.party_id = egm.party_id
WHERE egm.exposure_member_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 余额合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    gc.guarantor_party_id AS 担保人编号,
    p.display_name AS 担保人名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.security_id) AS 担保合同数量,
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS 担保金额合计
FROM guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN party p ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT gc.security_id) > 1
   AND SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) > 300000000
ORDER BY SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS 借据笔数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 借据笔数 DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT d.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown d
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON d.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON d.loan_id = ds.loan_id
WHERE ds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ds.principal_overdue_days >= 90
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY loan_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    p.display_name AS 借款方名称,
    pi.instruction_amount AS 指令金额,
    payee.display_name AS 收款方名称
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN payment_instruction pi ON ld.loan_id = pi.loan_id
JOIN party payee ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = payee.party_id
WHERE pi.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
  AND pi.intended_payee_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id AS 合同编号,
    p.display_name AS 借款方名称,
    ca.contract_amount AS 合同金额
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
WHERE p.status = 'FROZEN'
  AND p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
  AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    lpc.product_name_zh AS 产品中文名称,
    ind.sector_name_zh AS 投向行业,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS 放款金额
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_product_catalog lpc ON ld.drawdown_type = lpc.product_code
JOIN industry_sector ind ON ca.target_industry_code = ind.sector_code
WHERE lpc.product_family = 'WORKING_CAPITAL'
  AND ind.risk_category = 'EXIT'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS 本金余额,
    ROUND(avg_bal.avg_balance, 2) AS 机构平均余额,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance - avg_bal.avg_balance, 2) AS 超出差额
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN (
    SELECT ca.institution_id, AVG(lbs2.principal_balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld2
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld2.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs2 ON ld2.loan_id = lbs2.loan_id
    WHERE lbs2.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
) avg_bal ON ca.institution_id = avg_bal.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.principal_balance > 2 * avg_bal.avg_balance
ORDER BY 超出差额 DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN na.agreement_id IS NOT NULL THEN ca.contract_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS 非关联金额,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS 全部金额,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN na.agreement_id IS NOT NULL THEN ca.contract_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 0), 6) AS 占比
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT ca2.agreement_id
    FROM credit_agreement ca2
    JOIN account_holder ah ON ca2.borrower_party_id = ah.party_id
    JOIN party_relation pr ON ah.party_id = pr.source_party_id
    JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
    WHERE rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
) na ON ca.agreement_id = na.agreement_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 占比 DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS 余额合计,
    cs.net_capital AS 资本净额,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) AS 占比
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON ca.institution_id = cs.institution_id
    AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, p.party_id, cs.net_capital
HAVING SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital > 0.10
ORDER BY 占比 DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    p.display_name AS 借款人名称,
    ROUND(ca.annual_interest_rate, 4) AS 执行年利率,
    ROUND(avg_rate.avg_rate, 4) AS 所属目标行业平均利率,
    ROUND((ca.annual_interest_rate - avg_rate.avg_rate) * 100.0 / avg_rate.avg_rate, 2) AS 较行业平均上浮百分比
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN (
    SELECT
        target_industry_code,
        AVG(annual_interest_rate) AS avg_rate
    FROM credit_agreement
    WHERE target_industry_code IS NOT NULL
      AND annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY target_industry_code
) avg_rate ON ca.target_industry_code = avg_rate.target_industry_code
WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
  AND ca.target_industry_code IS NOT NULL
  AND (ca.annual_interest_rate - avg_rate.avg_rate) * 100.0 / avg_rate.avg_rate > 10
ORDER BY 较行业平均上浮百分比 DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.borrower_party_id) AS 超限客户数
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON ca.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ca.borrower_party_id IN (
      SELECT p.party_id 
      FROM party p 
      WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
  )
GROUP BY ca.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / MAX(cs.net_capital) > 0.10
ORDER BY 超限客户数 DESC;

SELECT 
    eg.exposure_group_id AS 集团编号,
    eg.group_name AS 集团名称,
    ROUND(SUM(lb.principal_balance), 2) AS 余额合计,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital, 2) AS 资本净额,
    ROUND(SUM(lb.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) AS 占比
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN party p ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lb ON lb.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = eg.institution_id
WHERE lb.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND eg.institution_id = ca.institution_id
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING SUM(lb.principal_balance) > cs.net_capital * 0.10
ORDER BY 占比 DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ca.maturity_on AS 合同到期日,
    ld.loan_id AS 未结清借据编号,
    ld.status AS 借据状态,
    ca.contract_amount AS 合同金额
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ca.status = 'MATURED'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.disbursement_account_id AS 发放账户编号,
    ld.disbursed_on AS 放款日期,
    pe.payment_id AS 转账流水号,
    pe.business_date AS 转账日期,
    pe.amount AS 转账金额,
    CAST(julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) AS INTEGER) AS 放款至转出的间隔天数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN payment_event pe 
    ON pe.from_account_id = ld.disbursement_account_id
    AND pe.status = 'SETTLED'
    AND pe.business_date > ld.disbursed_on
    AND julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) <= 7
ORDER BY 
    放款至转出的间隔天数 ASC,
    pe.amount DESC,
    ld.loan_id ASC;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_name,
        p.display_name AS customer_name,
        ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) AS ratio,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.institution_id ORDER BY SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital DESC) AS rn
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
    JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
    JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
    GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, p.party_id, p.display_name, cs.net_capital
)
SELECT institution_name, customer_name, ratio
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY institution_name ASC;

WITH ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        lb.loan_id,
        lb.principal_balance,
        NTILE(4) OVER (
            PARTITION BY ca.institution_id 
            ORDER BY lb.principal_balance DESC
        ) AS quartile
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lb
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON lb.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    WHERE lb.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT 
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    quartile
FROM ranked_loans
ORDER BY quartile ASC, principal_balance DESC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT 
    lb.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    lb.principal_balance AS 本金余额,
    ROUND(lb.principal_balance * 100.0 / inst_tot.total_principal, 2) AS 占比
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lb
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON lb.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN (
    SELECT ca.institution_id, SUM(lb2.principal_balance) AS total_principal
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lb2
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld2 ON lb2.loan_id = ld2.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld2.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    WHERE lb2.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
) inst_tot ON ca.institution_id = inst_tot.institution_id
WHERE lb.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY i.institution_name ASC, 占比 DESC, lb.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount, 2) AS 累计放款金额,
    ld.status AS 借据状态,
    ROUND(SUM(ds.overdue_principal), 2) AS 逾期本金合计,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ds.delinquency_id) AS 逾期期次数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ld.loan_id, ld.disbursed_amount, ld.status
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ds.delinquency_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 逾期期次数 DESC, 逾期本金合计 DESC, 借据编号 ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.disbursement_account_id AS 放款账户编号,
    ld.disbursed_on AS 放款日期,
    COUNT(*) AS 该日放款借据笔数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
GROUP BY ld.disbursement_account_id, ld.disbursed_on
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT DISTINCT ah.party_id
FROM account_holder ah
JOIN account a ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN term_deposit td ON a.account_id = td.account_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ah.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY ah.party_id ASC;

SELECT p.party_id
FROM party p
JOIN staff_member sm ON sm.person_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'STAFF'
  AND sm.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM account_holder ah
      WHERE ah.party_id = p.party_id
  )
ORDER BY p.party_id ASC;

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM payment_event pe
      WHERE pe.from_account_id = a.account_id
        AND pe.payment_type = 'CASH_WITHDRAWAL'
        AND pe.status = 'SETTLED'
  )
ORDER BY a.account_id ASC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT security_id, guaranteed_amount
FROM guarantor_commitment
WHERE status = 'EXPIRED'
ORDER BY guaranteed_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(current_maturity_on) < 0 THEN '已到期'
        WHEN julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(current_maturity_on) BETWEEN 0 AND 90 THEN '临期'
        ELSE '常态'
    END AS 档位,
    COUNT(*) AS 笔数
FROM loan_drawdown
GROUP BY 档位
ORDER BY CASE 档位 
    WHEN '常态' THEN 1 
    WHEN '临期' THEN 2 
    WHEN '已到期' THEN 3 
END;

SELECT 
    cl.collateral_id AS 押品编号,
    COUNT(cl.security_id) AS 关联次数
FROM collateral_link cl
INNER JOIN security_agreement sa ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY cl.collateral_id
HAVING COUNT(cl.security_id) > 1
ORDER BY COUNT(cl.security_id) DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_type AS 押品种类,
    ROUND(AVG(cv.valuation_amount), 2) AS 平均评估价值,
    COUNT(cv.valuation_id) AS 评估笔数
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN collateral_valuation cv ON ca.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
WHERE cv.appraiser_kind = 'INTERNAL'
GROUP BY ca.collateral_type
ORDER BY 平均评估价值 DESC;

WITH repayment_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.repayment_account_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    WHERE ld.repayment_account_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ld.repayment_account_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) >= 3
),
ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.repayment_account_id,
        ld.loan_id,
        ld.disbursed_on,
        ld.disbursed_amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY ld.repayment_account_id 
            ORDER BY ld.disbursed_on ASC, ld.loan_id ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    INNER JOIN repayment_counts rc ON ld.repayment_account_id = rc.repayment_account_id
)
SELECT 
    rl.repayment_account_id,
    rl.loan_id,
    rl.disbursed_on,
    rl.disbursed_amount,
    rc.loan_count
FROM ranked_loans rl
INNER JOIN repayment_counts rc ON rl.repayment_account_id = rc.repayment_account_id
WHERE rl.rn <= 2
ORDER BY rl.repayment_account_id ASC, rl.disbursed_on ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ca.contract_amount AS 合同金额,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 2) AS 累计放款金额,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) - ca.contract_amount, 2) AS 超合同投放金额,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS 放款笔数
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, ca.contract_amount
HAVING SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) > ca.contract_amount
ORDER BY ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ab.ledger_balance - ab.available_balance), 2) AS total_difference
FROM account a
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN account_balance_snapshot ab ON a.account_id = ab.account_id
WHERE ab.ledger_balance > ab.available_balance
  AND (ab.ledger_balance - ab.available_balance) > 5000000
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_difference DESC;

SELECT 
    t.account_id,
    t.opening_principal,
    t.maturity_on,
    t.annual_interest_rate
FROM term_deposit t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE t.maturity_on < '2026-06-30'
  AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY t.maturity_on ASC;

SELECT 
    pc.card_id AS 卡片编号,
    pc.card_type AS 卡片种类,
    pc.issued_on AS 签发日期
FROM payment_card pc
WHERE pc.card_type = 'DEBIT'
  AND pc.issued_on <= '2025-01-31'
  AND pc.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY pc.issued_on ASC, pc.card_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS 累计受托支付金额,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'SELF_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS 累计自主支付金额,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 6) AS 受托支付占比
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 受托支付占比 < 0.52
ORDER BY 受托支付占比 ASC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount, 2) AS 单笔放款金额,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.agreement_id), 2) AS 合同内累计放款金额,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount * 100.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.agreement_id), 2) AS 单笔占比
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_amount * 100.0 / SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY ld.agreement_id) > 90
ORDER BY ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.actual_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS 实际募集合计,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS 计划募集合计,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.actual_raise_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = 'ON_SALE' THEN wp.planned_raise_amount ELSE 0 END), 0), 6) AS 完成率
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN institution i ON wp.issuer_institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 完成率 > 1.2
ORDER BY 完成率 DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 借款人编号,
    p.display_name AS 借款人名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN ld.loan_id END) AS 逾期借据笔数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS 全部借据笔数
FROM party p
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
LEFT JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id AND rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN ld.loan_id END) > 0
   AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN ld.loan_id END) < COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id)
ORDER BY 逾期借据笔数 DESC, p.party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    pi.instruction_id AS 支付指令编号,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    p.display_name AS 借款人名称,
    payee.display_name AS 实际收款人名称,
    pi.instruction_amount AS 指令金额
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN party payee ON pi.intended_payee_party_id = payee.party_id
WHERE pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
  AND pi.intended_payee_party_id IS NOT NULL
  AND pi.intended_payee_party_id != ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC, pi.instruction_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.disbursed_on AS 放款日期,
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ca.signed_on AS 合同签署日期,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS 放款金额
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_on < ca.signed_on
ORDER BY ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    rs.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS 未结清期次数,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS 应还本金合计
FROM repayment_schedule rs
WHERE rs.loan_id NOT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT rs2.loan_id
    FROM repayment_schedule rs2
    WHERE rs2.status = 'PAID'
)
GROUP BY rs.loan_id
ORDER BY 应还本金合计 DESC, 借据编号 ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    l.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS 期末剩余本金,
    ROUND(lbs.overdue_principal, 2) AS 期末逾期本金
FROM loan_drawdown l
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON l.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE l.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'
  AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.principal_balance > 10000000
ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC, l.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.disbursed_on AS 放款日期,
    ld.disbursement_account_id AS 发放账户编号,
    a.opened_on AS 账户开立日期
FROM loan_drawdown ld
LEFT JOIN account a ON ld.disbursement_account_id = a.account_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_on < a.opened_on
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_on ASC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.disbursement_account_id AS 发放账户编号,
    a.account_kind AS 账户类型,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS 放款金额
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account a ON ld.disbursement_account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ca.security_type AS 担保方式,
    ca.contract_amount AS 合同金额,
    p.display_name AS 借款人名称
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE ca.security_type = 'CREDIT'
  AND ca.contract_amount > 8000000
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 借款人名称,
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    ca.annual_interest_rate AS 合同年利率,
    ROUND(avg_rate.avg_rate, 4) AS 同机构同类产品平均年利率,
    ROUND(ca.annual_interest_rate - avg_rate.avg_rate, 4) AS 利率价差
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        ca2.institution_id,
        ca2.product_family,
        AVG(ca2.annual_interest_rate) AS avg_rate
    FROM credit_agreement ca2
    WHERE ca2.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ca2.institution_id, ca2.product_family
) avg_rate ON ca.institution_id = avg_rate.institution_id 
          AND ca.product_family = avg_rate.product_family
WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate < avg_rate.avg_rate
  AND ca.borrower_party_id IN (
      SELECT DISTINCT pr.source_party_id
      FROM party_relation pr
      JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
      WHERE rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
  )
ORDER BY 利率价差 DESC;

SELECT 
    pr.source_party_id AS 关联方甲方编号,
    pr.target_party_id AS 关联方乙方编号,
    rtc.relation_name_zh AS 关联关系名称
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
WHERE pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM credit_agreement ca1
      WHERE ca1.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM credit_agreement ca2
      WHERE ca2.borrower_party_id = pr.target_party_id
  )
ORDER BY rtc.relation_name_zh ASC, pr.relation_id ASC;

SELECT 
    eg.group_name AS 集团名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.party_id) AS 成员数,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS 余额合计,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital, 2) AS 资本净额,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 6) AS 占比
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN party p ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id 
    AND ca.institution_id = eg.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = eg.institution_id
    AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE egm.effective_to IS NULL
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.party_id) >= 2
    AND SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital > 0.1
ORDER BY 占比 DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    payer.display_name AS 付款方姓名,
    payee.display_name AS 收款方姓名,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS 转账笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS 转账金额合计
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account from_acc ON pe.from_account_id = from_acc.account_id
JOIN account to_acc ON pe.to_account_id = to_acc.account_id
JOIN account_holder ah_from ON ah_from.account_id = from_acc.account_id
JOIN account_holder ah_to ON ah_to.account_id = to_acc.account_id
JOIN party payer ON payer.party_id = ah_from.party_id
JOIN party payee ON payee.party_id = ah_to.party_id
JOIN party_relation pr ON 
    (pr.source_party_id = ah_from.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = ah_to.party_id)
    OR 
    (pr.source_party_id = ah_to.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = ah_from.party_id)
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
WHERE pe.payment_type = 'TRANSFER'
  AND pe.status = 'SETTLED'
  AND rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
GROUP BY payer.display_name, payee.display_name
ORDER BY 转账金额合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_id AS 产品编号,
    wp.product_name AS 产品名称,
    ma.asset_name AS 底层资产名称
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
WHERE wp.status = 'ON_SALE'
  AND wp.risk_level = 'R5'
  AND phs.investment_path = 'NESTED_SPV'
ORDER BY wp.product_id ASC;

SELECT 
    phs.product_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT phs.asset_id) AS asset_count
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
WHERE phs.investment_path IN ('SPV', 'NESTED_SPV')
GROUP BY phs.product_id
ORDER BY asset_count DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS 账面本金余额,
    MAX(ds.principal_overdue_days) AS 最长逾期天数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
WHERE lbs.principal_balance > 90000000
  AND ds.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY ld.loan_id, lbs.principal_balance
HAVING MAX(ds.principal_overdue_days) >= 200
ORDER BY 最长逾期天数 DESC, 借据编号 ASC;

SELECT 
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.institution_id) AS involved_institution_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.borrower_party_id) AS member_count_with_credit
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON egm.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ca.institution_id) >= 2
ORDER BY involved_institution_count DESC;

SELECT 
    eg.exposure_group_id AS 集团编号,
    eg.group_name AS 集团名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.party_id) AS 逾期成员数,
    ROUND(SUM(ds.overdue_principal), 2) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN party p ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE ds.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
ORDER BY 逾期本金合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 企业名称,
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(DISTINCT gc.guaranteed_amount), 0), 2) AS 对外担保合计,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(DISTINCT ca.contract_amount), 0), 2) AS 自身借款合计,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(DISTINCT gc.guaranteed_amount), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(DISTINCT ca.contract_amount), 0), 2) AS 担保负债差额
FROM party p
JOIN organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COALESCE(SUM(DISTINCT gc.guaranteed_amount), 0) > COALESCE(SUM(DISTINCT ca.contract_amount), 0)
ORDER BY 担保负债差额 DESC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 员工姓名,
    sm.staff_id AS 员工编号,
    COUNT(ca.agreement_id) AS 授信合同笔数
FROM staff_member sm
JOIN party p ON sm.person_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE sm.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY p.display_name, sm.staff_id
ORDER BY 授信合同笔数 DESC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 借款人姓名,
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS 本金余额合计,
    pp.annual_income AS 年收入,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS 倍数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name, pp.annual_income
HAVING ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) > 2
ORDER BY 倍数 DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 员工姓名,
    so.operator_id AS 操作员编号,
    so.authority_level AS 权限级别,
    COUNT(ca.agreement_id) AS 自贷合同数
FROM staff_member sm
JOIN party p ON sm.person_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN service_operator so ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE so.operator_kind = '信贷经办员'
  AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY p.display_name, so.operator_id, so.authority_level
ORDER BY 自贷合同数 DESC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 员工姓名,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ld.disbursed_amount AS 放款金额,
    ld.disbursed_on AS 放款日期
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN payment_instruction pi ON ld.loan_id = pi.loan_id
JOIN account a ON pi.intended_payee_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON a.account_id = ah.account_id
JOIN party p ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN staff_member sm ON p.party_id = sm.person_party_id
WHERE ah.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
  AND p.party_type = 'STAFF'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 借款人姓名,
    p.party_id AS 借款人客户编号,
    pp.annual_income AS 个人年收入,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due + rs.interest_due), 2) AS 应还本息总额,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due + rs.interest_due) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS 占年收入倍数
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON p.party_id = ah.party_id
JOIN account a ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON a.account_id = ld.loan_account_id
JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
  AND pp.annual_income IS NOT NULL
  AND pp.annual_income > 0
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name, pp.annual_income
ORDER BY 占年收入倍数 DESC, p.party_id ASC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT 
    lpc.product_family AS 产品类别名称,
    COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS 逾期期数,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM repayment_schedule rs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_product_catalog lpc ON ld.drawdown_type = lpc.product_code
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY lpc.product_family
ORDER BY 逾期本金合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 已过期笔数,
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on >= '2026-06-30' AND td.maturity_on < date('2026-06-30', '+90 days') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 九十天内到期笔数,
    SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on >= date('2026-06-30', '+90 days') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 九十天以上到期笔数
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 20
ORDER BY 已过期笔数 DESC, 机构名称 ASC;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id AS 营业单元编号,
    ou.unit_name AS 营业单元名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS 联合账户数量
FROM organization_unit ou
JOIN account a ON a.org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON ah.account_id = a.account_id
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ah.party_id) > 1
ORDER BY 联合账户数量 DESC;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id AS 营业单元编号,
    ou.unit_name AS 营业单元名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS 逾期笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.overdue_principal), 2) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ca.managing_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 逾期本金合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    rs.loan_id AS 贷款编号,
    COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS 逾期期数,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM repayment_schedule rs
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY rs.loan_id
HAVING SUM(rs.principal_due) > 120000000
ORDER BY 逾期本金合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS 逾期期数,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.interest_due), 2) AS 利息合计
FROM repayment_schedule rs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(rs.installment_id) >= 30
ORDER BY 逾期期数 DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT rs.loan_id) AS overdue_loan_count
FROM institution i
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON ld.loan_id = rs.loan_id
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT rs.loan_id) >= 240
ORDER BY overdue_loan_count DESC;

SELECT 
    r.loan_id AS 贷款编号,
    r.installment_no AS 期次序号,
    r.principal_due AS 应还本金,
    r.interest_due AS 应还利息
FROM repayment_schedule r
WHERE r.status = 'OVERDUE'
  AND r.principal_due > 90000000
ORDER BY r.principal_due DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount), 2) AS 授信额度合计,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 2) AS 发放金额合计,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital, 2) AS 资本净额,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 4) AS 发放对资本占比
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN credit_facility cf ON i.institution_id = cf.institution_id
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
LEFT JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
LEFT JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) > cs.net_capital
ORDER BY 发放对资本占比 DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id AS 担保合同编号,
    sa.secured_amount AS 设定担保金额,
    COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS 保证人个数,
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS 保证金额合计
FROM security_agreement sa
LEFT JOIN guarantor_commitment gc 
    ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id 
    AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE sa.security_type = 'GUARANTEE'
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY 保证金额合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    cf.facility_id AS 授信额度编号,
    cf.limit_amount AS 授信限额,
    sc.name_zh AS 额度状态名称
FROM credit_facility cf
LEFT JOIN status_catalog sc 
    ON sc.entity = 'credit_agreement' 
    AND sc.status_code = cf.status
WHERE cf.facility_type = 'REVOLVING'
ORDER BY cf.limit_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    cf.facility_type AS 授信类型代码,
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount), 2) AS 授信限额合计
FROM credit_facility cf
JOIN institution i ON cf.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY cf.institution_id, cf.facility_type
HAVING SUM(cf.limit_amount) > 2000000000
ORDER BY SUM(cf.limit_amount) DESC;

SELECT 
    facility_type AS 授信类型,
    COUNT(*) AS 记录数
FROM credit_facility
WHERE limit_amount > 300000000
GROUP BY facility_type
ORDER BY 记录数 DESC;

SELECT 
    pmc.payment_mode_name_zh AS 支付方式中文名称,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS 记录数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
LEFT JOIN payment_mode_catalog pmc ON ld.payment_mode = pmc.payment_mode
GROUP BY ld.payment_mode, pmc.payment_mode_name_zh
ORDER BY 记录数 DESC;

WITH ranked_products AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        actual_raise_amount,
        minimum_holding_days,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY actual_raise_amount DESC) AS quartile_group
    FROM wealth_product
    WHERE status = 'ON_SALE'
),
filtered_products AS (
    SELECT 
        quartile_group,
        COUNT(*) AS product_count
    FROM ranked_products
    WHERE minimum_holding_days > 0
    GROUP BY quartile_group
    HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 31 AND 33
)
SELECT 
    quartile_group AS group_no,
    product_count
FROM filtered_products
ORDER BY quartile_group ASC;

SELECT 
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount), 2) AS 循环授信限额合计,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS 发放笔数
FROM credit_facility cf
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON cf.facility_id = ca.facility_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE cf.facility_type = 'REVOLVING'
  AND ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT'
GROUP BY cf.facility_id
ORDER BY 循环授信限额合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    pmc.payment_mode_name_zh AS 支付方式中文名称,
    COUNT(pi.instruction_id) AS 待执行指令数量
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN payment_mode_catalog pmc ON pi.payment_mode = pmc.payment_mode
WHERE pi.status = 'PENDING'
GROUP BY pi.payment_mode, pmc.payment_mode_name_zh
ORDER BY 待执行指令数量 DESC;

SELECT 
    it.name_zh AS 融资工具中文名称,
    sc.name_zh AS 实体状态中文名称
FROM instrument_type_catalog it
CROSS JOIN status_catalog sc
WHERE sc.entity = 'loan_drawdown'
ORDER BY it.name_zh, sc.name_zh;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id AS 营业单元编号,
    ou.unit_name AS 营业单元名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sa.staff_id) AS 信贷客户经理人数
FROM organization_unit ou
LEFT JOIN staff_assignment sa ON sa.org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
    AND sa.role_code = 'CREDIT_MANAGER'
    AND sa.effective_from <= '2026-06-30'
    AND (sa.effective_to IS NULL OR sa.effective_to >= '2026-06-30')
WHERE ou.unit_type = 'BRANCH'
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 信贷客户经理人数 DESC;

SELECT 
    d.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    cg.grade_name_zh AS 五级分类名称,
    ds.principal_overdue_days AS 本金逾期天数,
    ds.overdue_principal AS 逾期本金
FROM delinquency_snapshot ds
JOIN loan_drawdown d ON ds.loan_id = d.loan_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON d.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE ds.principal_overdue_days > 30
  AND cg.grade_code = 'NORMAL'
  AND ds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND rc.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY ds.principal_overdue_days DESC, d.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
WHERE ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ps.provision_stage = '2'
  AND ps.recognized_amount * 1.0 / NULLIF(ps.required_amount, 0) < 0.5
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY loan_count DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount), 2) AS provision_gap_total
FROM provision_snapshot p
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON p.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE p.required_amount > p.recognized_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY provision_gap_total DESC, i.institution_name ASC;
