SELECT p.customer_segment AS 客户分层, COUNT(DISTINCT p.party_id) AS 客户数量
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
  AND pp.annual_income > 1000000
GROUP BY p.customer_segment
ORDER BY 客户数量 DESC, 客户分层 ASC;

SELECT 
    asset_category_primary AS 主要资产类别,
    COUNT(*) AS 资产数量
FROM managed_asset
WHERE industry_code IN (
    SELECT sector_code 
    FROM industry_sector 
    WHERE risk_category = 'RESTRICTED'
)
GROUP BY asset_category_primary
HAVING COUNT(*) < 33
ORDER BY 资产数量 DESC, 主要资产类别 ASC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    pp.annual_income AS 年收入,
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount), 2) AS 授信额度合计,
    ROUND(SUM(cf.limit_amount) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income, 2) AS 偿债比
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
JOIN credit_facility cf ON cf.obligor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
  AND pp.annual_income > 0
GROUP BY p.party_id, pp.annual_income
HAVING SUM(cf.limit_amount) * 1.0 / pp.annual_income > 3
ORDER BY 偿债比 DESC, p.party_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    pp.occupation_code AS 职业代号,
    pp.employment_sector AS 就业板块,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.party_id) AS 客户数量
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
GROUP BY pp.occupation_code, pp.employment_sector
ORDER BY 客户数量 DESC, 职业代号 ASC, 就业板块 ASC;

SELECT 
    pc.status AS 卡状态,
    COUNT(pc.card_id) AS 发卡数量
FROM payment_card pc
JOIN card_type_catalog ctc ON pc.card_type = ctc.card_type
WHERE ctc.name_zh = '借记卡'
GROUP BY pc.status
ORDER BY 发卡数量 DESC, 卡状态 ASC;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id AS 营业单元编号,
    ou.unit_name AS 营业单元名称,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS 交易笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS 金额合计
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN payment_card pc ON pe.from_account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
JOIN account a ON pc.settlement_account_id = a.account_id
JOIN party p ON pc.holder_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON p.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE pc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
  AND pe.payment_type = 'CASH_WITHDRAWAL'
  AND pe.status = 'SETTLED'
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 金额合计 DESC, 营业单元名称 ASC;

SELECT 
    pe.payment_id AS 交易编号,
    pc.card_id AS 银行卡编号,
    pc.holder_party_id AS 持卡人编号,
    pe.business_date AS 交易日期,
    pe.amount AS 交易金额
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN payment_card pc ON pe.from_account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
JOIN card_type_catalog ctc ON pc.card_type = ctc.card_type
WHERE ctc.name_zh = '贷记卡'
  AND pe.is_cash = 1
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC, pe.payment_id ASC, pc.card_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    pc.holder_party_id AS 持卡人编号,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS 现金交易笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS 金额合计
FROM payment_card pc
JOIN payment_event pe ON pe.from_account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
WHERE pc.card_type = 'CREDIT'
  AND pe.payment_type IN ('CASH_DEPOSIT', 'CASH_WITHDRAWAL')
  AND pe.status = 'SETTLED'
GROUP BY pc.holder_party_id
HAVING COUNT(pe.payment_id) > 5
ORDER BY 现金交易笔数 DESC, 金额合计 DESC;

SELECT holder_party_id AS 持卡人编号, COUNT(card_id) AS 发卡数量
FROM payment_card
GROUP BY holder_party_id
HAVING COUNT(card_id) > 3
ORDER BY 发卡数量 DESC, 持卡人编号 ASC;

SELECT 
    c.name_zh AS 银行卡类型名称,
    COUNT(p.payment_id) AS 交易笔数,
    ROUND(AVG(p.amount), 2) AS 平均单笔金额
FROM payment_card pc
JOIN card_type_catalog c ON pc.card_type = c.card_type
JOIN payment_event p ON pc.settlement_account_id = p.from_account_id
WHERE p.is_cash = 1
  AND p.status = 'SETTLED'
  AND pc.card_type IN ('CREDIT', 'DEBIT')
GROUP BY pc.card_type, c.name_zh
ORDER BY 平均单笔金额 DESC, 银行卡类型名称 ASC;

SELECT 
    pe.channel AS 交易渠道,
    COUNT(*) AS 交易数量,
    ROUND(AVG(pe.amount), 2) AS 平均金额
FROM payment_event pe
WHERE pe.status = 'SETTLED'
  AND pe.is_cash = 0
GROUP BY pe.channel
HAVING AVG(pe.amount) > 11780000
ORDER BY 平均金额 DESC, 交易渠道 ASC;

SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    td.maturity_on,
    a.status
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30'
  AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY td.maturity_on DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    MAX(cv.valuation_amount) AS max_valuation_amount
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN collateral_valuation cv ON ca.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
GROUP BY ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label
HAVING COUNT(cv.valuation_id) >= 2
ORDER BY max_valuation_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.collateral_id AS 押品编号,
    ca.asset_label AS 押品标识,
    COUNT(cl.collateral_link_id) AS 押品被引用次数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.security_id) AS 关联不同担保合同数
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN collateral_link cl ON ca.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id
WHERE cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label
HAVING COUNT(cl.collateral_link_id) >= 2
ORDER BY COUNT(cl.collateral_link_id) DESC, ca.collateral_id ASC;

SELECT 
    gc.guarantor_party_id AS 保证人客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ROUND(gc.guaranteed_amount, 2) AS 保证承诺金额,
    ROUND(ld.total_disbursed, 2) AS 该合同实际放款总金额
FROM guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN party p ON gc.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON gc.security_id = so.security_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN (
    SELECT agreement_id, SUM(disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed
    FROM loan_drawdown
    GROUP BY agreement_id
) ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND gc.guaranteed_amount > ld.total_disbursed
ORDER BY gc.guaranteed_amount DESC, gc.guarantor_party_id ASC, ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id AS 授信合同编号,
    ca.borrower_party_id AS 债务人编号,
    ca.contract_amount AS 授信合同金额,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(so.covered_amount), 0), 2) AS 担保覆盖合计,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount - COALESCE(SUM(so.covered_amount), 0), 2) AS 保障缺口
FROM credit_agreement ca
LEFT JOIN secured_obligation so ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
LEFT JOIN security_agreement sa ON so.security_id = sa.security_id AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, ca.borrower_party_id, ca.contract_amount
HAVING ROUND(ca.contract_amount - COALESCE(SUM(so.covered_amount), 0), 2) > 0
ORDER BY 保障缺口 DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
JOIN provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
WHERE cg.grade_code = 'SUBSTANDARD'
  AND ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
  AND rc.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cg.grade_code, cg.grade_name_zh
ORDER BY loan_count DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT
    ca.borrower_party_id AS 债务人编号,
    ld.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS 贷款余额,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS 授信金额,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance * 1.0 / ca.contract_amount, 2) AS 余额倍数
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND lbs.principal_balance * 1.0 / ca.contract_amount >= 4
ORDER BY 余额倍数 DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    cg.grade_name_zh AS 五级分类名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS 多计提笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(ps.recognized_amount - ps.required_amount), 2) AS 多计提金额合计
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
JOIN provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
WHERE cg.is_nonperforming = 1
  AND ps.recognized_amount > ps.required_amount
  AND rc.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY i.institution_name, cg.grade_name_zh
ORDER BY 多计提金额合计 DESC, i.institution_name ASC, cg.grade_name_zh ASC;

SELECT
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN cv.valuation_type = 'INTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END), 2) AS internal_max_value,
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN cv.valuation_type = 'EXTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END), 2) AS external_max_value,
    ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN cv.valuation_type = 'INTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END) - MAX(CASE WHEN cv.valuation_type = 'EXTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END), 2) AS undervaluation_gap
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN collateral_valuation cv ON ca.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
WHERE cv.valuation_type IN ('INTERNAL', 'EXTERNAL')
GROUP BY ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label
HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN cv.valuation_type = 'INTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END) IS NOT NULL
   AND MAX(CASE WHEN cv.valuation_type = 'EXTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END) IS NOT NULL
   AND MAX(CASE WHEN cv.valuation_type = 'INTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END) > MAX(CASE WHEN cv.valuation_type = 'EXTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END)
ORDER BY undervaluation_gap DESC;

SELECT
    ca.collateral_id AS 抵质押物编号,
    ca.asset_label AS 资产名称,
    ROUND(latest_val.valuation_amount, 2) AS 最新评估价,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(cl.pledged_amount), 0), 2) AS 累计质押额,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(cl.pledged_amount), 0) - latest_val.valuation_amount, 2) AS 覆盖缺口
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN (
    SELECT
        cv.collateral_id,
        cv.valuation_amount,
        cv.valued_on
    FROM collateral_valuation cv
    JOIN (
        SELECT collateral_id, MAX(valued_on) AS max_valued_on
        FROM collateral_valuation
        GROUP BY collateral_id
    ) latest ON cv.collateral_id = latest.collateral_id AND cv.valued_on = latest.max_valued_on
) latest_val ON ca.collateral_id = latest_val.collateral_id
LEFT JOIN collateral_link cl ON ca.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label, latest_val.valuation_amount
HAVING COALESCE(SUM(cl.pledged_amount), 0) > latest_val.valuation_amount
ORDER BY 覆盖缺口 DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 保证人编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    ROUND(SUM(DISTINCT ca.contract_amount), 2) AS 自身借款金额合计,
    ROUND(SUM(DISTINCT gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS 对外保证金额合计
FROM party p
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id AND ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING SUM(DISTINCT gc.guaranteed_amount) > SUM(DISTINCT ca.contract_amount)
ORDER BY 对外保证金额合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id AS 担保合同编号,
    ROUND(sa.secured_amount, 2) AS 担保债权金额,
    COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS 保证人数量,
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS 保证承诺金额合计
FROM security_agreement sa
LEFT JOIN guarantor_commitment gc 
    ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id 
    AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
HAVING SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) < sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY 保证承诺金额合计 DESC;

SELECT p.customer_segment, COUNT(DISTINCT p.party_id) AS customer_count
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'
  AND pp.is_public_official = 1
  AND pp.annual_income >= 300000
GROUP BY p.customer_segment
ORDER BY customer_count DESC, p.customer_segment ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    egt.name_zh AS group_type_name_zh,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN institution i ON eg.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN exposure_group_type_catalog egt ON eg.group_type = egt.group_type
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
GROUP BY i.institution_name, egt.name_zh
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 6
ORDER BY member_count DESC;

SELECT 
    egm.party_id AS 成员客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS 所属集团数量
FROM exposure_group_member egm
JOIN party p ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY egm.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 所属集团数量 DESC, 成员客户编号 ASC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 主体编号,
    p.display_name AS 主体名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_id) AS 关联关系条数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS 借款合同笔数
FROM party p
LEFT JOIN party_relation pr 
    ON (pr.source_party_id = p.party_id OR pr.target_party_id = p.party_id)
    AND pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca 
    ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 
      FROM party_relation pr2 
      WHERE (pr2.source_party_id = p.party_id OR pr2.target_party_id = p.party_id)
        AND pr2.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 
      FROM credit_agreement ca2 
      WHERE ca2.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
  )
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 关联关系条数 DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS 所属集团数量
FROM party p
JOIN party_relation pr ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON p.party_id = egm.party_id
WHERE rtc.relation_name_zh = '影子股东'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 所属集团数量 DESC, p.party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    pr.relation_id,
    pr.source_party_id,
    pr.target_party_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca1.agreement_id) AS source_agreement_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca2.agreement_id) AS target_agreement_count
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca1 ON pr.source_party_id = ca1.borrower_party_id
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca2 ON pr.target_party_id = ca2.borrower_party_id
WHERE rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
GROUP BY pr.relation_id, pr.source_party_id, pr.target_party_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ca1.agreement_id) > 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ca2.agreement_id) > 0
ORDER BY (COUNT(DISTINCT ca1.agreement_id) + COUNT(DISTINCT ca2.agreement_id)) DESC;

SELECT c.collateral_id, c.asset_label, c.collateral_type
FROM collateral_asset c
WHERE c.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM collateral_link cl
      WHERE cl.collateral_id = c.collateral_id
        AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
  )
ORDER BY c.collateral_id ASC;

SELECT
    g.guarantor_party_id AS 保证人编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    ROUND(SUM(g.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS 有效保证责任合计,
    ROUND(COALESCE(loan_bal.self_loan_amount, 0), 2) AS 自身贷款金额,
    ROUND(SUM(g.guaranteed_amount) - COALESCE(loan_bal.self_loan_amount, 0), 2) AS 超额担保金额
FROM guarantor_commitment g
JOIN party p ON g.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS self_loan_amount
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
      AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
) loan_bal ON g.guarantor_party_id = loan_bal.borrower_party_id
WHERE g.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND g.effective_to IS NULL
GROUP BY g.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name, loan_bal.self_loan_amount
HAVING SUM(g.guaranteed_amount) > COALESCE(loan_bal.self_loan_amount, 0)
ORDER BY 超额担保金额 DESC;

SELECT 
    g.guarantor_party_id AS 保证人编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    g.guaranteed_amount AS 保证金额,
    g.status AS 保证状态
FROM guarantor_commitment g
JOIN party p ON g.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE g.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND g.guarantor_party_id IN (
      SELECT DISTINCT ca.borrower_party_id
      FROM loan_drawdown ld
      JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
      JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
      WHERE ds.principal_overdue_days > 0
  )
ORDER BY g.guaranteed_amount DESC, g.guarantor_party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    ma.obligor_party_id AS final_debtor_id,
    ROUND(SUM(ds.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ma.obligor_party_id = ld.borrower_party_id
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
WHERE wp.status = 'ON_SALE'
  AND phs.lookthrough_depth > 0
  AND ma.obligor_party_id IS NOT NULL
  AND ds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY wp.product_name, ma.asset_name, ma.obligor_party_id
ORDER BY wp.product_name ASC, total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_type AS 担保方式,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sa.security_id) AS 担保合同笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(so.covered_amount), 2) AS 被担保金额合计
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN secured_obligation so ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sa.security_type
ORDER BY 被担保金额合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS contract_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.collateral_id) AS collateral_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
LEFT JOIN collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, p.display_name, ca.contract_amount
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS 成员去重数量,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS 合同金额合计
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN institution i ON eg.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
WHERE eg.group_type = '关联客户型敞口集团'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 5
ORDER BY 合同金额合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_id AS 产品编号,
    wp.product_name AS 产品名称,
    ROUND(SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value), 2) AS 倒挂金额合计,
    COUNT(*) AS 构成倒挂的持仓笔数
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
WHERE phs.carrying_amount > phs.fair_value
GROUP BY wp.product_id, wp.product_name
HAVING SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value) > 0
ORDER BY 倒挂金额合计 DESC, wp.product_id ASC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_name AS 产品名称,
    ma.asset_name AS 底层资产名称,
    phs.lookthrough_depth AS 嵌套深度,
    phs.carrying_amount AS 持仓账面价值,
    ROUND(SUM(ds.overdue_principal), 2) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN wealth_product wp ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ma.obligor_party_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
WHERE phs.lookthrough_depth >= 3
  AND ca.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id
  AND ds.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY wp.product_name, ma.asset_name, phs.lookthrough_depth, phs.carrying_amount, phs.holding_id
ORDER BY phs.lookthrough_depth DESC, phs.holding_id ASC;

SELECT 
    cl.collateral_id,
    COUNT(*) AS first_lien_active_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cl.pledge_ratio > 0.60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS over_sixty_count
FROM collateral_link cl
WHERE cl.lien_priority = 1
  AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY cl.collateral_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY over_sixty_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(fs.total_assets, 2) AS total_assets,
    ROUND(fs.total_liabilities, 2) AS total_liabilities,
    ROUND(fs.net_assets, 2) AS net_assets,
    ROUND(fs.annual_revenue, 2) AS annual_revenue
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN financial_snapshot fs 
    ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
    AND fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY fs.annual_revenue DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(fs.total_liabilities) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(fs.total_assets), 0), 4) AS debt_to_asset_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY debt_to_asset_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(cs.tier1_capital * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets, 6) AS core_tier1_capital_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY core_tier1_capital_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital * 1.0 / fs.total_assets, 6) AS net_capital_to_assets_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
    AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
    AND fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE fs.total_assets IS NOT NULL AND fs.total_assets > 0
ORDER BY net_capital_to_assets_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    ROUND(fs.annual_revenue, 2) AS 营业收入,
    ROUND(fs.annual_revenue * 1.0 / total_rev.total_revenue, 6) AS 占比
FROM financial_snapshot fs
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = REPLACE(fs.party_id, 'PTY-', '')
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        REPLACE(party_id, 'PTY-', '') AS institution_id,
        SUM(annual_revenue) AS total_revenue
    FROM financial_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
    GROUP BY institution_id
) total_rev ON total_rev.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE fs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND fs.annual_revenue IS NOT NULL
  AND fs.annual_revenue * 1.0 / total_rev.total_revenue > 0.15
ORDER BY 占比 DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ma.asset_id) AS inconsistent_asset_count
FROM managed_asset ma
JOIN institution i ON ma.originator_institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE ma.internal_rating IS NOT NULL 
  AND ma.external_rating IS NOT NULL 
  AND ma.internal_rating != ma.external_rating
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY inconsistent_asset_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ma.valuation_method,
    ROUND(SUM(phs.carrying_amount), 2) AS total_carrying_amount
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
GROUP BY ma.valuation_method
ORDER BY total_carrying_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS 笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(td.opening_principal), 2) AS 本金合计
FROM account a
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN term_deposit td ON a.account_id = td.account_id
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 本金合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(td.account_id) AS deposit_certificate_count
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE td.annual_interest_rate > 3
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY deposit_certificate_count DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.role_code AS authorization_level,
    COUNT(DISTINCT so.operator_id) AS operator_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS staff_count
FROM staff_assignment sa
JOIN staff_member sm ON sa.staff_id = sm.staff_id
JOIN service_operator so ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
WHERE sa.role_code IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY sa.role_code
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) >= 10
ORDER BY operator_count DESC, authorization_level ASC;

SELECT 
    ou.unit_name AS 机构名称,
    COUNT(td.account_id) AS 笔数
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON a.org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE td.maturity_on >= '2026-06-30'
  AND td.maturity_on <= date('2026-06-30', '+30 days')
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 笔数 DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount), 2) AS under_provision_total,
    fs.net_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount) * 1.0 / fs.net_assets, 6) AS under_provision_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN provision_snapshot ps ON ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE ps.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ps.required_amount > ps.recognized_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, fs.net_assets
HAVING SUM(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount) > 0
ORDER BY under_provision_ratio DESC, i.institution_id ASC;

SELECT 
    cg.grade_name_zh AS 风险分类名称,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS 借据数量
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE cg.is_nonperforming = 1
  AND rc.classification_basis = '人工认定'
GROUP BY cg.grade_name_zh
HAVING COUNT(ld.loan_id) BETWEEN 60 AND 105
ORDER BY 借据数量 DESC, 风险分类名称 ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_id AS 机构编号,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS 不良借据笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(ds.overdue_principal), 2) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
LEFT JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE ds.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND rc.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ds.principal_overdue_days >= 90
  AND cg.is_nonperforming = 1
GROUP BY i.institution_id
HAVING ROUND(SUM(ds.overdue_principal) * 1.0 / NULLIF(MAX(fs.annual_revenue), 0), 6) > 0.5
ORDER BY 逾期本金合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS total_principal_balance,
    cs.risk_weighted_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets, 6) AS loan_to_rwa_percentage
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id AND cs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND lbs.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.risk_weighted_assets
ORDER BY loan_to_rwa_percentage DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    pi.payment_mode AS 结算方式,
    COUNT(pi.instruction_id) AS 待执行指令数量
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE pi.status = 'PENDING'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY pi.payment_mode
HAVING COUNT(pi.instruction_id) > 45
ORDER BY 待执行指令数量 DESC, 结算方式 ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(r.record_id) AS abnormal_record_count,
    SUM(r.amount_value) AS abnormal_amount,
    c.net_capital,
    f.total_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(r.amount_value) * 1.0 / c.net_capital * 100, 4) AS abnormal_to_capital_pct
FROM ai_system_record_v3 r
JOIN institution i ON r.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN capital_snapshot c ON r.institution_id = c.institution_id AND c.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
JOIN financial_snapshot f ON f.party_id = 'PTY-' || r.institution_id AND f.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
WHERE r.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, c.net_capital, f.total_assets
HAVING COUNT(r.record_id) >= 8
ORDER BY abnormal_to_capital_pct DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.record_id) AS 监管报送逾期记录数,
    ROUND(AVG(lb.principal_balance), 2) AS 台账平均金额,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS 拨备不足借据数,
    ROUND(SUM(pr.required_amount - pr.recognized_amount), 2) AS 拨备缺口金额
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
LEFT JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
LEFT JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lb ON ld.loan_id = lb.loan_id AND lb.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
LEFT JOIN provision_snapshot pr ON ld.loan_id = pr.loan_id AND pr.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
LEFT JOIN regulatory_submission_event_v3 r ON i.institution_id = r.institution_id
    AND r.event_date <= '2026-06-30'
    AND (r.completion_date IS NULL OR r.completion_date > r.deadline_date)
    AND r.exception_flag = 1
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND pr.required_amount > pr.recognized_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.record_id) >= 25
ORDER BY 拨备缺口金额 DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS 授信额度批复总数,
    ROUND(SUM(gov.amount_value), 2) AS 治理异常记录金额,
    ROUND(AVG(gov.ratio_value), 4) AS 平均观测比值
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
LEFT JOIN governance_control_record_v3 gov ON i.institution_id = gov.institution_id AND gov.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN gov.exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 END) >= 5
ORDER BY 治理异常记录金额 DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.target_party_id) AS 关联目标主体数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_type) AS 关系种类数,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rt.relation_name_zh != '非关联方' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 非关联方关系笔数
FROM related_transaction_record_v3 rtr
JOIN party p ON rtr.subject_id = p.party_id
JOIN party_relation pr ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id
LEFT JOIN relation_type_catalog rt ON pr.relation_type = rt.relation_type
WHERE rtr.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 关联目标主体数 DESC, 关系种类数 DESC, 客户名称 ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) AS valid_card_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.holder_party_id) AS card_holder_count,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ore.exception_flag = 1 THEN ore.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS operational_risk_exception_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ore.record_id) AS operational_risk_valid_record_count
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN organization_unit ou ON i.institution_id = ou.institution_id
LEFT JOIN account a ON ou.org_unit_id = a.org_unit_id
LEFT JOIN payment_card pc ON a.account_id = pc.settlement_account_id AND pc.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN operational_risk_event_v3 ore ON i.institution_id = ore.institution_id AND ore.status_code = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE pc.card_id IS NOT NULL OR ore.record_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ore.record_id) >= 43
ORDER BY operational_risk_exception_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT wp.product_id) AS 在售产品数,
    ROUND(SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount), 2) AS 实际募集合计,
    COUNT(pe.record_id) AS 产品行为记录数,
    ROUND(AVG(pe.observed_value), 4) AS 平均比值
FROM institution i
JOIN wealth_product wp ON i.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id
LEFT JOIN product_conduct_event_v3 pe ON wp.product_id = pe.subject_id
WHERE wp.status = 'ON_SALE'
  AND pe.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(pe.record_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 实际募集合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ma.asset_id) AS underlying_asset_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ma.issued_amount), 2) AS total_issued_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cor.record_id) AS custody_valid_record_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cor.exception_flag = 1 THEN cor.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS total_exception_amount
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN managed_asset ma ON i.institution_id = ma.originator_institution_id
LEFT JOIN custody_operation_event_v3 cor ON i.institution_id = cor.institution_id AND cor.status_code = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE i.institution_id IN (
    SELECT cor2.institution_id
    FROM custody_operation_event_v3 cor2
    WHERE cor2.status_code = 'ACTIVE' AND cor2.exception_flag = 1
    GROUP BY cor2.institution_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cor2.record_id) >= 2
)
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_issued_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;
